decision.note: Current Kew/POWO treats Opuntia senilis Daul as a synonym of accepted O. orbiculata. O. orbiculata is native to Texas at state level, but this pass does not lock three exact project target-zone counties under the accepted concept. Do not create a duplicate O. senilis learner page.

field_note: Large rounded-pad pricklypear concept; can be confused with the broad Texas pricklypear complex. Identification should use pad shape, areole/glochid pattern, spine number/length and fruit rather than the obsolete name alone.
learner_guardrail: Fold the source row into an O. orbiculata research concept. Keep out of native totals and canonical installation until exact target-zone county evidence is resolved.
